title: rf-ticket's publish check tells added finding records apart from edits to existing records
acceptance: After publish, .claude/workflows/rf-ticket.js returns needs-review unless every change since the reviewed head is a newly added RF record, the ticket's own record changing only its evidence, or the re-rendered board, as AGENTS.md › Delegation And Merge Policy allows; an edit to any other existing record, or to the ticket's own status or acceptance, counts as unreviewed.

The check reads the change list from git output the publish agent returns verbatim (git diff --name-status and the ticket record's diff), and a dry run with mocked agents covers an added record, an evidence-only edit, a status edit and another record's edit.
nextAction: Agent-created from #799's second fresh-context review (P2, 2026-11-24): the publish check accepts any path under ritmofit_dev_plan/tasks/, so an edit to an existing record would pass it. The conductor's stage 7 check still catches it. Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Second fresh-context review of #799 at 2079b47 found the path-only RECORDS_ONLY check (P2, not significant).
